### LIMITK
Collects an arbitrary sample of up to `k` values for a field. Shorthand for `SAMPLE(field, k)`, and the ES|QL aggregate analogue of PromQL `limitk(k, v)`.

```esql
FROM employees
| SORT emp_no
| LIMIT 3
| STATS sample = MV_SORT(LIMITK(first_name, 99))
```
